name: hud_duel_corked_cell_explains_the_bottles
description: The duel bar's rival row ends with its corked bottles' tier and candidates (M8, contract-m8 §4) inside the rival's Seawall cell, which since 0.8.0 explains the Seawall when hovered (hud_duel_seawall_tip). The two are joined so each explains itself: on Undertow's own rules with a rival seat that corks a pack of window 2 through the sequencer, hovering the corked cell shows the bar's plate about the bottle, in the Drift tray's words ('Your rival's corked bottle', 'Tier I, corked for wave 2. It holds one of: ... Which one stays hidden until it is uncorked.', Game.rival_bottle_text), not the Seawall; the play harness names the cell as the rival's corked bottles; moving onto the rest of the cell (its Seawall icon) the plate speaks of the rival's Seawall again, and off the bar it goes.

steps.msg: a duel with a rival seat no caretaker plays
both Ready: the horn sounds wave 1
the rival corks a pack of window 2
the rival's row ends with the corked bottle

steps.assert: node('DuelBar').tip_shown()[0] == "Your rival's corked bottle" and node('SeawallTip').visible
steps.msg: hovering the corked cell explains the bottle, not the Seawall

steps.assert: node('DuelBar').tip_shown()[1] == Game.rival_bottle_text(Game.rival_bottles()[0], Game.rival_bottles()) and node('DuelBar').tip_shown()[1].begins_with('Tier I, corked for wave 2. It holds one of: ') and node('DuelBar').tip_shown()[1].ends_with('. Which one stays hidden until it is uncorked.')
steps.msg: in the Drift tray's words: its tier, its wave and the packs it may hold, never which
as the tray's own bottle says it

steps.assert: said.contains("duel tip: Your rival's corked bottle · Tier I, corked for wave 2. It holds one of: ") and resource('res://tools/play/describe.gd')._hover_words(node('Corked')) == "your rival's corked bottles on the duel bar" and resource('res://tools/play/describe.gd')._hover_words(node('Seawall1').get_child(0)) == "your rival's Seawall on the duel bar"
steps.msg: the play harness says the plate and names the corked cell apart from the rival's Seawall

steps.assert: Game.sim.seawall_charges(2) == 2 and node('DuelBar').tip_shown() == ['Your rival\'s Seawall', 'It bursts round your rival\'s Holdfast as yours does round yours. 2 charges.']
steps.msg: on the rest of the cell, the rival's Seawall again (its two charges from wave 1's leaks)
